description: A slice of the Kubernetes API: namespaces, pods, configmaps and deployments, with watch and scenario settings.
name: kubernetes-mock

settings.description: Forced HTTP status for every call on the listener; 0 is off, otherwise 400 to 599.
settings.name: error_status

settings.description: When true every call is answered 429 with a Retry-After header.
settings.name: throttle

settings.description: Milliseconds every call waits before it is answered; 0 is off.
settings.name: latency_ms

settings.description: A watch opened while this is N ends its stream after N events; 0 means never.
settings.name: drop_watch_after_events
